lines.t: Let It Live
Verse 1
Oh daughter of mine, I gave you life,
Now you’ve grown and you’re a wife,
To the one your heart chose truly,
And now, my child, my baby you carry.​
Chorus
Let it live, let it grow,
Don’t let your decision shade what you know,
A precious baby growing inside,
Let it live — this gift you can’t hide.​
Verse 2
Don’t make incision on what I gave,
All knit together, so wondrously made,
Let the little limbs start to unfurl,
Nourish it gently, as life takes its whirl.​
Bridge
For now the fetus is still real small,
But your love will help it grow tall,
You and your husband are now a pair,
Made one together, in love and prayer.​
Chorus
Let it live, let it grow,
Don’t let your decision shade what you know,
God gave this baby, a love so wide,
Let it live — nurture what’s inside.​
Verse 3
He prays for you every day,
So you will listen and obey,
He is meek and mild — he is mine,
A father’s joy, by God’s design.​
Chorus / Outro
Let it live, oh let it stay,
This little miracle is on the way,
Heed my words and let it live,
For this little baby is the gift I give
Chorus
Let it live, let it grow,
Don’t let your decision shade what you know,
A precious baby growing inside,
Let it live — this gift you can’t hide.​
